20872.d: Promethium & Fractite Mine is a mine on the Daemonheim peninsula.

gt.heading: Travel
gt.text:
This is one of the more remote mines around Daemonheim, positioned at the northwest corner, at the outermost ring of the peninsula.

The Dungeoneering cape's teleport to the Kal'gerion resource dungeon is very useful. Once there, players can simply run north to the edge of the peninsula to reach the mine.

From the teleport destination of the ring of kinship, players must run all the way south first to reach the outermost ring, go west, and instead of going towards the Wilderness gate to the southwest, take the northwest path and go all the way north. Alternatively, teleport to the Daemonheim Dig Site by using the Archaeology journal and the Dig sites map and run the same route.

gt.text:
• There is a permanent crop circle in the Zanaris wheat field. 
• Random wheat fields may spawn a crop circle to teleport the player. Certain fields are favoured by players owing to their proximity to banks and skilling areas. Additionally, the Farmer's Affinity bonus can make it easier to catch imps, and generally speeds up the game. Perhaps the most popular wheat fields would be those in Catherby and Yanille.

20981.d: Pyramid Plunder is a Thieving minigame located in the city of Sophanem at the far southern reaches of the Kharidian Desert.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
Search an anonymous looking door on the pyramid to enter the room with the guardian mummy to start the game. The pyramid is the northern pyramid in the city of Sophanem. You can get there in several ways:
• Master camouflage outfit Pyramid Plunder teleport
• Pharaoh's sceptre teleport to Jalsavrah Pyramid. Exit the pyramid.
• Teleport to Menaphos lodestone , then run east across the bridge to Sophanem (requires completion of The Jack of Spades and Contact!).
• Teleport to Al Kharid lodestone, and use the magic carpet network to get to Sophanem.
